svg.aria-label: GrabMedia: Saves public Instagram and YouTube media up to 2160p through a backend proxy. Pipeline: BUILD, HARDEN, DEPLOY, LIVE complete. Hardened with Helmet headers, rate limiting, API key kept server-side. Stack: Node.js · Express · Helmet.
